recipes.title: Chicken Crunch Wrap
instructions: Cut tomatoes and lettuce
Yogurt sauce- Add garlic, salt and pepper to Greek yogurt
Season cut chicken piece with salt garlic, onion, paprika, oregano, cumin, Chilli flakes
Cook chicken for 5-6 mins in a pan until done with some oil.
Assemble wrap with tortilla and toast on pan till brown.

recipes.title: Burrito Bowl
instructions: Cook Fresh rice
Cut and prep veggies- onion, bell pepper
Cut Chicken and season with oil, garlic power, onion powder, Paprika, cumin powder, oregano, add pepper and salt.
Salsa - corn, tomato, onion, lime, salt/pepper.
Cook the chicken
Saute veggies with little salt
Make cilantro lime rice with butter, salt and pepper.
Plate the dish with Cheese garnish.
recipes.notes: Substitute chicken with Panner/ Soya/ Potatoes.

recipes.title: Lentil Sambaar
instructions: Saute mustard seeds, onion, tomato, Veggies and garlic for 5 mins.
Add toor daal and pressure cook for 3 Whistles with Salt
After cooker cools; Add water, sambaar powder, chilli powder and boil
Add Tamarind paste/extract
Adjust salt and spice and serve with Hot Rice

recipes.title: Afghani Egg Curry
instructions: Boil eggs.
Satue Onion, Ginger, garlic, Green chilli with butter; Blend with water & Cilantro to make a paste.
Temper oil with Jeera, Cinnamon, Bay leaf, Clove and add the paste and cook it.
Add chilli powder, Coriander powder, little Cumin powder, Garam masala and cook.
Adjust consistency using water.
Add curd and boiled eggs.
Cook for 10 mins.
Garnish with Cilantro leaves and serve with Chapati or Rice.

recipes.title: Pasta Arabiata
instructions: Boil Pasta with salt
Add butter to the pan
Cook the onions in butter untill done 50 %
then add garlic and cook for few mins
Then add blended tomatoes to the pan and cook
Add seasonings
Add the boiled pasta and cook for few mins
Add cheese and adjust consistency
Finish off with cilantro

recipes.title: Panner Butter masala
instructions: Add butter and Bay leaf, clove, cardamom, Cinnamon, cashew
Cook onion, Kashmiri  Red Chilli and tomato in butter and spices
Let it cool; remove hard spices and blend mixture
Add oil+ butter to the pan and put back hard spices, Green chilli, and add jeera
Add the blended mixture to pan and cook more
Add Chilli powder, garam masala, coriander powder
Add water and adjust consistency
add Panner, milk and fresh cream.
Cook and adjust consistency
Finish off with kasthuri mehti and cilantro
recipes.notes: Use Chicken instead of panner for butter chicken.

recipes.title: Mushroom Donne Biriyani
instructions: Soak Rice
Add Oil Bay leaf, Marathi Moggu, cardamom and fry for 2min
Add sliced onion, Mushroom, turmeric powder salt and cook
Make a  paste of Cilantro, Mint, Green Chilli, Little Onion, Pepper corns, GGP, Clove and water
Add pate to partially cooked mushroom and cook
Blend 2 tomatoes and add to the pot.
Add kasthuri Methi
Cook the mixture then add 1:2 Water and wait till it boils
Adjust salt add lemon juice and rice
Cover with Foil and boil Rice until Done

recipes.title: Avocado Toast
instructions: Cut tomato, onion, lime salt, cilantro and mix with avocado
Season Guac
Toast bread
Add Guac to Bread and serve
Add fried egg on top

recipes.title: Chicken tacos
instructions: Airfry chicken
Toast tortilla
Add chicken, sauces, coleslaw to tortilla and serve
recipes.notes: Can make a dry chicken fry for filling.
